design.decision: The opening lead: lead a [♦] honor at once instead of the strongest lead.
design.opponent: Revealed on trick one; when opponents lead first they can avoid leading [♦].
design.rationale: A single, sharp opening-lead decision for Suits, at a narrow-event amount; it fires in roughly a quarter of rounds.
design.draftText: +40 contract points when your team wins the first trick of a round with [♦]

critic.concerns: The owner only controls trick one when their team leads it, so it often fires or misses by seat; third first-trick variant beside cb-first-trick-mult and ca-ace-first-trick.
